questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The water is ____ cold to swim in. (너무 차가워서 수영할 수 없다)
questions.why: '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'는 「too+형용사+to부정사」로 쓴다. so는 뒤에 that절이 와야 하고 very에는 부정의 뜻이 없다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? Mike is old ____ to ride a bike alone. (혼자 자전거를 탈 만큼 나이가 충분히 들었다)
questions.why: '~할 만큼 충분히 …한'은 「형용사+enough+to부정사」이며 enough는 형용사 뒤에 온다. too를 쓰면 '탈 수 없다'는 반대 뜻이 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? This bag is too heavy ____ carry.
questions.why: too ~ to부정사 구문이므로 동사원형 carry 앞에 to를 쓴다. that과 so는 뒤에 절이 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The rope was long enough ____ reach the ground.
questions.why: 「형용사+enough+to부정사」구문이므로 to reach가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 것은?
choices: He is enough tall to touch the ceiling.
He is tall enough to touch the ceiling.
He is tall enough touching the ceiling.
He is enough tall touching the ceiling.
He is tall too enough to touch the ceiling.
questions.why: enough는 형용사 tall 뒤에 오고 뒤에는 to부정사가 온다. enough tall이나 enough touching은 모두 틀린 어순·형태이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: The soup is too salty to eating.
The soup is too salty eat.
The soup is too salty to eat.
The soup is too salty for eat.
The soup is salty too to eat.
questions.why: too+형용사 뒤에는 to+동사원형이 온다. to eating, for eat, to 없는 형태는 모두 틀리다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The night was ____ dark that we couldn't see the road.
questions.why: 뒤에 that절이 이어지므로 so ~ that 구문이다. too는 to부정사와 짝을 이루고 that절과 함께 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? He was so hungry ____ he ate two hamburgers.
questions.why: so+형용사 뒤에 절이 이어지므로 접속사 that을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The box is light enough to carry. = The box is ____ light ____ I can carry it.
questions.why: 「형용사+enough+to-v」는 「so+형용사+that+주어+can」으로 바꿔 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The tea is too hot to drink. = The tea is so hot ____ I can't drink it.
questions.why: 「too ~ to-v」는 「so ~ that+주어+can't」로 바꿔 쓰므로 접속사 that이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말과 뜻이 같은 것은? 그 상자는 너무 무거워서 내가 들 수 없다.
choices: The box is too heavy for me to lift.
The box is too heavy for me to lift it.
The box is enough heavy for me to lift.
The box is too heavy that I can't lift.
The box is so heavy for me to lift.
questions.why: too ~ for+목적격+to-v 형태로 쓴다. to lift의 목적어가 주어 The box와 같으므로 it을 다시 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? My sister is not old ____ to watch this horror movie. (이 공포 영화를 볼 만큼 충분히 나이가 들지 않았다)
questions.why: '~할 만큼 충분히 나이 든'은 old enough이고, 앞에 not이 붙으면 '충분히 ~하지 않다'가 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말은? (1) He is rich ____ to buy that car. (2) The room is warm ____ to sleep in.
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 '~할 만큼 충분히'라는 뜻이므로 형용사 뒤에 enough를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말은? (1) I was ____ shy to speak in front of people. (2) The music was ____ loud to enjoy.
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'는 뜻이므로 too를 쓴다. so는 that절이 필요하다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? Amy runs fast ____ to win the race.
questions.why: enough는 부사 fast 뒤에 와서 '충분히 빠르게'라는 뜻을 만든다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The movie was too boring ____ watch to the end.
questions.why: too ~ to부정사 구문이므로 to watch가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
choices: She is kind enough to help us.
He is too weak to open the door.
The bed is soft enough to sleep in.
I am enough busy to meet you.
They were too late to catch the train.
questions.why: enough는 형용사 뒤에 와야 하므로 enough busy가 아니라 busy enough로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices: The ice was thick enough to walk on.
The question was too difficult to answer.
He spoke slowly enough for us to understand.
She was too sick to going to school.
The park is close enough to walk to.
questions.why: too ~ to 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 to going이 아니라 to go가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? He got up ____ late to have breakfast. (너무 늦게 일어나서 아침을 먹지 못했다)
questions.why: 부사 late 앞에 too를 써서 '너무 늦게 ~해서 …할 수 없다'는 뜻을 나타낸다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? She sings well ____ to join the school band.
questions.why: 부사 well 뒤에 enough를 써서 '충분히 잘'이라는 뜻을 만든다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? Tom is too young to ride the roller coaster. = Tom is so young that he ____ ride the roller coaster.
questions.why: too ~ to는 부정의 뜻을 담고 있으므로 so ~ that절에서는 can't를 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? This water is clean enough to drink. = This water is so clean that we ____ drink it.
questions.why: enough to는 '~할 수 있다'는 긍정의 뜻이므로 that절에는 can을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? The show was so funny that we couldn't stop laughing. = The show was ____ funny ____ stop laughing.
questions.why: 「so ~ that+주어+couldn't」는 「too ~ to-v」로 바꿔 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? She was so strong that she could carry the bag. = She was strong ____ to carry the bag.
questions.why: 「so ~ that+주어+could」는 「형용사+enough+to-v」로 바꿔 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말과 뜻이 같은 것은? 그는 그 시험에 합격할 만큼 충분히 열심히 공부했다.
choices: He studied hard enough to pass the exam.
He studied enough hard to pass the exam.
He studied too hard to pass the exam.
He studied hard enough passing the exam.
He studied hard enough for passing the exam.
questions.why: 부사 hard 뒤에 enough를 쓰고 그 뒤에 to부정사를 쓴다. too hard는 '너무 열심히 해서 합격할 수 없었다'는 반대 뜻이 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말과 뜻이 같은 것은? 그 아이는 너무 어려서 학교에 갈 수 없다.
choices: The child is too young to go to school.
The child is too young not to go to school.
The child is young enough to go to school.
The child is too young to going to school.
The child is very young to go to school.
questions.why: too ~ to-v 자체가 '…할 수 없다'는 뜻이므로 not을 넣지 않는다. young enough는 반대의 뜻이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The chair was ____ old that it broke.
questions.why: 뒤에 that절이 이어지므로 so를 쓴다. such는 뒤에 명사가 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? It is warm enough ____ us to swim in the lake.
questions.why: to부정사의 의미상 주어는 「for+목적격」으로 나타낸다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The bench was too small ____ three people to sit on.
questions.why: too ~ to 구문에서 행위의 주체를 밝힐 때는 to부정사 앞에 for+목적격을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고친 것은? She is <u>enough smart</u> to solve the puzzle.
questions.why: enough가 형용사를 꾸밀 때는 반드시 형용사 뒤에 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? He is too short to reach the shelf.
choices: He is so short that he can't reach the shelf.
He is so short that he can reach the shelf.
He is short enough to reach the shelf.
He is so tall that he can reach the shelf.
He is very short to reach the shelf.
questions.why: too ~ to는 「so ~ that+주어+can't」와 같은 뜻이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것은? The room is big enough to hold twenty people.
choices: The room is so big that it can hold twenty people.
The room is so big that it can't hold twenty people.
The room is too big to hold twenty people.
The room is very big to hold twenty people.
The room is so small that it can hold twenty people.
questions.why: enough to는 '~할 수 있을 만큼'이라는 뜻이므로 so ~ that + can으로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? He is ____ to travel alone. (혼자 여행할 만큼 나이가 충분히 들었다)
questions.why: '충분히 나이 든'은 old enough이다. too old는 '너무 늙어서 여행할 수 없다'는 뜻이 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The coffee was ____ to drink. (너무 뜨거워서 마실 수 없었다)
questions.why: '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'는 too+형용사+to-v이다. hot enough는 '마실 만큼 충분히 뜨겁다'는 뜻이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? She was too nervous ____ a word.
questions.why: too ~ 뒤에는 to+동사원형이 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The ladder is long enough ____ the roof.
questions.why: enough 뒤에는 to+동사원형이 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: The car is enough fast to win.
The car is fast enough to win.
The car is fast to enough win.
The car is enough to fast win.
The car is fast enough win.
questions.why: enough는 부사 fast 뒤에 오고, 그 뒤에 to부정사가 이어져야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? Jane is too weak to lift the chair. = Jane is not ____ to lift the chair.
questions.why: '너무 약해서 들 수 없다'는 '충분히 힘이 세지 않다'와 같은 뜻이므로 not strong enough로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The ring was so expensive that I couldn't buy it. = The ring was ____ for me to buy.
questions.why: 「so ~ that+주어+couldn't」는 「too ~ for+목적격+to-v」로 바꿔 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? He is ____ tired ____ walk any more.
questions.why: '너무 피곤해서 더 걸을 수 없다'이므로 too ~ to를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? The ice is thick ____ ____ skate on.
questions.why: 형용사 thick 뒤에 enough를 쓰고 이어서 to부정사를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? He speaks English well enough ____ a job in Canada.
questions.why: well enough 뒤에는 to+동사원형이 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? It was ____ windy to fly a kite safely. (바람이 너무 세서 연을 안전하게 날릴 수 없었다)
questions.why: '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'는 too+형용사+to-v로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 자연스러운 문장은?
choices: She was too shy that she couldn't sing.
She was so shy that she couldn't sing.
She was so shy to sing.
She was enough shy that she couldn't sing.
She was too shy that she can't sing.
questions.why: that절과 함께 쓰는 것은 too가 아니라 so이다. too는 to부정사와 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The pizza was big enough for four people ____ share.
questions.why: for four people은 의미상 주어이고 그 뒤에는 to부정사가 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말과 뜻이 같은 것은? 이 신발은 내가 신기에 너무 작다.
choices: These shoes are too small for me to wear.
These shoes are too small for me to wear them.
These shoes are small enough for me to wear.
These shoes are too small that I can't wear.
These shoes are enough small for me to wear.
questions.why: to wear의 목적어가 문장의 주어 These shoes와 같으므로 them을 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The teacher spoke slowly ____ for us to understand.
questions.why: 부사 slowly 뒤에 enough를 써서 '충분히 천천히'라는 뜻을 만든다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 <u>잘못된</u> 것은?
choices: I am too full to eat more.
He is smart enough to fix the computer.
The dog was too small to jump over the fence.
We arrived early enough to get good seats.
The tea is enough sweet to drink.
questions.why: enough는 형용사 sweet 뒤에 와야 하므로 sweet enough로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. He is strong ____ to carry the heavy box. (충분히 강한)
questions.why: '~할 만큼 충분히'는 형용사 뒤에 enough를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. The soup is ____ hot to eat. (너무 뜨거워서 먹을 수 없다)
questions.why: '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'는 too+형용사+to-v로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. She is <u>enough old</u> to drive a car.
questions.why: enough가 형용사를 꾸밀 때는 형용사 뒤에 온다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. The tea is too hot <u>drink</u>.
questions.why: too+형용사 뒤에는 to+동사원형을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. The rope is long enough to reach the floor. = The rope is ____ long that it can reach the floor.
questions.why: 「형용사+enough+to-v」는 「so+형용사+that+주어+can」으로 바꿔 쓴다.

questions.stem: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오. The bag is too heavy for me to lift. = The bag is so heavy that I ____ lift it.
alt: cannot
can not
questions.why: too ~ to는 부정의 뜻이므로 that절에 can't를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 too ~ to 구문을 사용해 다시 쓰시오. (for me를 포함할 것) The box is so heavy that I can't move it.
questions.answer: The box is too heavy for me to move.
questions.why: 「so ~ that+주어+can't」는 「too ~ for+목적격+to-v」로 바꾸며, to move의 목적어 it은 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 so ~ that 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (that절의 주어는 he로 쓸 것) He is tall enough to reach the ceiling.
questions.answer: He is so tall that he can reach the ceiling.
alt: He is so tall that he can reach the ceiling
questions.why: enough to는 긍정의 뜻이므로 that절에 can을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. She was too tired (walk) any farther.
questions.why: too+형용사 뒤에는 to부정사가 온다.

questions.stem: 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 두 단어를 쓰시오. 그는 그 개를 구할 만큼 충분히 용감했다. → He was ____ to save the dog.
questions.why: '충분히 용감한'은 brave enough이며 enough는 형용사 뒤에 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. The book is ____ difficult for me to read. (너무 어려운)
questions.why: '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'는 too+형용사+for+목적격+to-v이다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. The ice is <u>thick enough walk</u> on.
questions.why: enough 뒤에는 to+동사원형이 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. He was so weak <u>to</u> he couldn't stand up.
questions.why: so+형용사 뒤에 절이 이어지므로 접속사 that을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 enough를 사용하여 7단어의 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. The water is so clean that we can drink it.
questions.answer: The water is clean enough to drink.
alt: The water is clean enough to drink
questions.why: 「so ~ that+주어+can」은 「형용사+enough+to-v」로 바꾸고, 목적어 it은 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 so ~ that 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (that절의 주어는 I로 쓸 것) The tea is too hot to drink.
questions.answer: The tea is so hot that I can't drink it.

questions.why: too ~ to를 so ~ that으로 바꿀 때는 can't를 쓰고, drink의 목적어 it을 반드시 되살려 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. It is warm ____ for us to go swimming. (충분히 따뜻한)
questions.why: 형용사 warm 뒤에 enough를 쓰고 의미상 주어 for us를 이어 쓴다.

questions.stem: 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. 그녀는 너무 늦게 도착해서 그 영화를 볼 수 없었다. → She arrived ____ late to see the movie.
questions.why: 부사 late 앞에 too를 써서 '너무 늦게 ~해서 …할 수 없다'를 나타낸다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 too ~ to 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. My father is <u>so busy that he can't</u> play with me.
questions.why: 「so+형용사+that+주어+can't」는 「too+형용사+to-v」로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. The hall is big enough (hold) fifty people.
questions.why: enough 뒤에는 to+동사원형이 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 too ~ to 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. He is so young that he can't join the club.
questions.answer: He is too young to join the club.
alt: He is too young to join the club
questions.why: 「so ~ that+주어+can't」는 「too ~ to-v」로 바꿔 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? The lecture was ____ boring that half of the students fell asleep.
questions.why: 뒤에 that절이 이어지므로 so ~ that 구문이다. too는 to부정사와 함께 쓰고, such 뒤에는 명사가 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? The instructions were clear enough for everyone ____ follow.
questions.why: 「형용사+enough+for+목적격+to-v」구조이므로 to follow가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것은? The suitcase was too heavy for Emma to carry.
choices: The suitcase was so heavy that Emma could carry it.
The suitcase was so heavy that Emma couldn't carry it.
The suitcase was so heavy that Emma couldn't carry.
The suitcase was heavy enough for Emma to carry.
The suitcase was so heavy that she can't carry it.
questions.why: too ~ to는 so ~ that + 부정으로 바꾸고, 주절이 과거이므로 couldn't를 쓴다. 또 carry의 목적어 it을 반드시 되살려야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 too ~ to 구문으로 바르게 바꾼 것은? The soup was so salty that I couldn't finish it.
choices: The soup was too salty for me to finish.
The soup was too salty for me to finish it.
The soup was too salty that I couldn't finish.
The soup was too salty not to finish.
The soup was so salty for me to finish.
questions.why: that절의 주어는 for me로 바꾸고, finish의 목적어 it은 주어와 같으므로 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 enough의 위치가 알맞은 것은?
choices: He is enough rich to travel abroad.
He has enough money to travel abroad.
He runs enough fast to win the race.
She was enough brave to speak up.
The road is enough wide to drive on.
questions.why: enough는 명사 앞에는 올 수 있지만 형용사·부사는 뒤에서 꾸민다. 따라서 enough money는 맞고 enough rich 등은 틀리다.

questions.stem: 다음 〈보기〉에서 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ⓐ She is enough kind to help me. ⓑ The ice was thick enough to skate on. ⓒ He was too tired to walk home. ⓓ It was too cold that we couldn't go out.
questions.why: ⓑ와 ⓒ가 옳다. ⓐ는 kind enough, ⓓ는 so cold that으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 부분은? The boy was <u>so</u> <u>frightened</u> <u>that</u> he <u>can't</u> <u>say</u> a word.
questions.why: 주절의 동사가 과거(was)이므로 that절도 couldn't가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 부분을 고르면? The stage was <u>bright</u> <u>enough</u> <u>for</u> the audience <u>seeing</u> <u>the actors</u>.
questions.why: enough 뒤에는 to부정사가 와야 하므로 seeing이 아니라 to see로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그 얼음은 그 위에서 스케이트를 탈 만큼 충분히 두껍지 않았다.
choices: The ice was not thick enough to skate on.
The ice was not enough thick to skate on.
The ice was too thick to skate on.
The ice was not thick enough to skate on it.
The ice was so thick that we could skate on.
questions.why: not+형용사+enough+to-v로 쓰며, on의 목적어가 주어 The ice와 같으므로 it을 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말은? (1) The path was ____ narrow for two people to walk side by side. (2) She spoke ____ fast for me to catch every word.
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'는 뜻이므로 too를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? A: Why didn't you buy the jacket? B: It was ____.
choices: too expensive for me to buy
too expensive for me to buy it
very expensive that I couldn't buy
questions.why: too+형용사+for+목적격+to-v 형태가 알맞고, buy의 목적어 it은 주어(It)와 같으므로 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? Daniel practiced ____ hard that he became the team captain.
questions.why: 뒤에 that절이 이어지므로 so+부사+that 구문을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? The soup was cool enough for the baby to eat.
choices: The soup was so cool that the baby could eat it.
The soup was so cool that the baby couldn't eat it.
The soup was too cool for the baby to eat.
The soup was so cool that the baby can eat it.
The soup was not cool enough for the baby to eat.
questions.why: enough to는 긍정의 뜻이고 문장이 과거이므로 could를 쓰며, eat의 목적어 it을 되살려야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? My grandmother is ____ to go up the stairs by herself. (혼자 계단을 오를 만큼 건강하시다)
questions.why: '~할 만큼 충분히 건강한'은 healthy enough이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices: The hall was large enough to hold 500 people.
The story was too sad for the children to enjoy.
He was so angry that he couldn't speak.
The tea was too hot for me to drink it.
She is old enough to take care of herself.
questions.why: to drink의 목적어가 문장의 주어 The tea와 같으므로 it을 쓰면 안 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그 질문은 너무 어려워서 학생들이 답할 수 없었다.
choices: The question was too difficult for the students to answer.
The question was too difficult for the students to answer it.
The question was so difficult for the students to answer.
The question was too difficult that the students couldn't answer.
The question was enough difficult for the students to answer.
questions.why: too ~ for+목적격+to-v로 쓰고, answer의 목적어는 주어와 같으므로 it을 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? The gym is big ____ for us ____ play basketball in.
questions.why: '~할 만큼 충분히 큰'이므로 big enough for us to play가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 so ~ that 구문으로 바르게 바꾼 것은? Nick was strong enough to push the car.
choices: Nick was so strong that he could push the car.
Nick was so strong that he couldn't push the car.
Nick was so strong that he can push the car.
Nick was so strong to push the car.
Nick was too strong that he could push the car.
questions.why: 과거 문장이므로 that절에 could를 쓴다. so ~ to나 too ~ that은 성립하지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? Kate stayed up ____ late to get up early the next morning. (너무 늦게까지 깨어 있어서 다음 날 일찍 일어날 수 없었다)
questions.why: 부사 late 앞에 too를 써서 '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'를 나타낸다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고친 것은? The chair was <u>so old to</u> sit on safely. (너무 낡아서 안전하게 앉을 수 없었다)
questions.why: so는 that절과 함께 쓰고, to부정사와 짝을 이루는 것은 too이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 <u>다른</u> 것은?
choices: There is <u>enough</u> food in the fridge.
He earns <u>enough</u> money to live on.
She is tall <u>enough</u> to be a model.
I bought <u>enough</u> paper for the project.
questions.why: ①②③⑤의 enough는 명사를 꾸미는 형용사이고, ④는 형용사 tall을 뒤에서 꾸미는 부사이다.

questions.stem: 다음 〈보기〉에서 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수를 고르면? ⓐ He ran fast enough to catch the bus. ⓑ The box was too heavy to lift it. ⓒ She was so tired that she fell asleep. ⓓ The water is enough warm to swim in.
questions.why: ⓐ와 ⓒ가 옳다. ⓑ는 it을 빼야 하고, ⓓ는 warm enough로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The little girl is ____ to reach the light switch. (너무 키가 작아서 닿을 수 없다)
questions.why: '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'는 too+형용사+to-v이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것은? The wind was so strong that we couldn't open the umbrella.
choices: The wind was too strong for us to open the umbrella.
The wind was too strong for us not to open the umbrella.
The wind was strong enough for us to open the umbrella.
The wind was too strong that we couldn't open the umbrella.
The wind was so strong for us to open the umbrella.
questions.why: 「so ~ that+주어+couldn't」는 「too ~ for+목적격+to-v」로 바꾼다. too ~ to 자체가 부정의 뜻이므로 not을 넣지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? A: Can Sam join the marathon? B: Sure. He is ____ run 20 kilometers.
questions.why: '~할 만큼 충분히 건강한'은 fit enough to-v이다. too fit to run은 '너무 건강해서 달릴 수 없다'는 어색한 뜻이 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 곳을 바르게 고친 것은? He didn't study enough hard to pass the test.
questions.why: enough는 부사 hard를 뒤에서 꾸미므로 hard enough가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? A: Why don't we sit outside? B: Let's stay in. It is ____ today.
choices: too cold that we can't sit
questions.why: '너무 추워서 앉을 수 없다'이므로 too cold to sit outside가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 enough를 사용해 바르게 바꾼 것은? The rope was so long that it could reach the second floor.
choices: The rope was long enough to reach the second floor.
The rope was enough long to reach the second floor.
The rope was too long to reach the second floor.
The rope was long enough reaching the second floor.
The rope was long enough that it reached the second floor.
questions.why: 「so ~ that+주어+could」는 「형용사+enough+to-v」로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그 상자는 아이가 옮길 만큼 충분히 가벼웠다.
choices: The box was light enough for a child to move.
The box was enough light for a child to move.
The box was light enough for a child to move it.
The box was too light for a child to move.
The box was so light for a child to move.
questions.why: light enough for+목적격+to-v로 쓰며, move의 목적어는 주어와 같으므로 it을 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? The problem was ____ complex ____ a beginner to solve.
questions.why: '너무 복잡해서 초보자가 풀 수 없다'이므로 too complex for a beginner to solve가 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 맞는 문장은?
choices: The bridge is strong enough for trucks to cross.
The bridge is enough strong for trucks to cross.
The bridge is strong enough for trucks crossing.
The bridge is too strong for trucks to cross it.
The bridge is so strong for trucks to cross.
questions.why: 형용사+enough+for+목적격+to부정사 형태가 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 <u>다른</u> 것은? The coat was too small for Jane to wear.
choices: The coat was so small that Jane couldn't wear it.
Jane couldn't wear the coat because it was too small.
The coat wasn't big enough for Jane to wear.
The coat was so small that Jane could wear it.
Jane found the coat too small to wear.
questions.why: too ~ to는 '…할 수 없다'는 뜻이므로 could를 쓴 ④만 뜻이 반대이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? There was ____ time for us to visit the museum before lunch. (충분한 시간)
questions.why: enough가 명사 time을 꾸밀 때는 명사 앞에 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 <u>어색한</u> 것은?
choices: We had enough snacks to share with everyone.
The car was fast enough to pass the truck.
He is too honest to tell a lie.
The pool is deep enough for children to swim in.
The night was too quiet that I could hear my heartbeat.
questions.why: that절과 함께 쓰이는 것은 so이므로 so quiet that으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 too ~ to 구문으로 바르게 바꾼 것은? The desk is so wide that it can't go through the door.
choices: The desk is too wide to go through the door.
The desk is too wide to go through it.
The desk is too wide that it can't go through the door.
The desk is wide enough to go through the door.
The desk is so wide to go through the door.
questions.why: 주어가 같으므로 의미상 주어를 따로 쓰지 않고 too wide to go through the door로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? Mr. Kim speaks Chinese well enough ____ business in Shanghai.
questions.why: enough 뒤에는 to+동사원형이 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? A: Did you finish the book? B: No. It was ____ long for me to finish in a day.
questions.why: '너무 길어서 하루에 다 읽을 수 없었다'이므로 too를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 부분은? The road was <u>too</u> <u>icy</u> <u>for</u> the bus <u>to climb</u> <u>it</u>.
questions.why: to climb의 목적어가 문장의 주어 The road와 같으므로 it을 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그녀는 너무 화가 나서 한마디도 할 수 없었다.
choices: She was too angry to say a word.
She was too angry not to say a word.
She was so angry to say a word.
She was angry enough to say a word.
She was too angry that she couldn't say a word.
questions.why: too ~ to 자체에 부정의 뜻이 있으므로 not을 넣지 않으며, too는 that절과 함께 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The film was too long for the kids to sit through. = The film was so long that the kids ____ sit through it.
questions.why: too ~ to는 부정의 뜻이고 문장이 과거이므로 couldn't를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The suitcase was light ____ for the old man to lift with one hand.
questions.why: '한 손으로 들 만큼 충분히 가벼운'이므로 light enough가 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고친 것은? The children were <u>enough excited</u> to jump up and down.
questions.why: enough는 형용사 excited 뒤에 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 so ~ that 구문으로 바르게 바꾼 것은? The shirt was too dirty for Mom to wash by hand.
choices: The shirt was so dirty that Mom couldn't wash it by hand.
The shirt was so dirty that Mom could wash it by hand.
The shirt was so dirty that Mom couldn't wash by hand.
The shirt was so dirty for Mom that she couldn't wash it.
The shirt was so dirty that Mom can't wash it by hand.
questions.why: 과거 문장이므로 couldn't를 쓰고, wash의 목적어 it을 반드시 되살려야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? A: Is the museum far from here? B: No, it is ____ walk to.
questions.why: '걸어갈 만큼 충분히 가까운'은 close enough to이다.

questions.stem: 다음 〈보기〉에서 어법상 옳은 문장은 모두 몇 개인가? ⓐ The bag was too small to put all my books in. ⓑ He is enough strong to lift the rock. ⓒ It was so windy that we stayed inside. ⓓ She is kind enough to lend me her umbrella.
questions.why: ⓐ, ⓒ, ⓓ가 옳다. ⓑ는 strong enough로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 too의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 <u>다른</u> 것은?
choices: The bag is <u>too</u> heavy to carry.
He was <u>too</u> tired to finish the work.
The shoes are <u>too</u> small for me to wear.
It is <u>too</u> dark to read here.
questions.why: ④의 too는 '~도 또한'이라는 뜻이고, 나머지는 too ~ to 구문의 '너무'라는 뜻이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 so ~ that 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. The suitcase was too heavy for Emma to carry.
questions.answer: The suitcase was so heavy that Emma couldn't carry it.
alt: The suitcase was so heavy that Emma could not carry it.
questions.why: too ~ to는 so ~ that + couldn't로 바꾸고, carry의 목적어 it을 되살려 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 too ~ to 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (for me를 포함할 것) The soup was so salty that I couldn't finish it.
questions.answer: The soup was too salty for me to finish.
alt: The soup was too salty for me to finish
questions.why: that절의 주어는 for me로 바꾸고 목적어 it은 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. He didn't study <u>enough hard</u> to pass the exam.
questions.why: enough는 부사를 뒤에서 꾸미므로 hard enough가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. The instructions were clear enough for everyone ____ follow.
questions.why: enough 뒤에는 to부정사가 온다.

questions.stem: 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 두 단어를 쓰시오. 그 얼음은 스케이트를 탈 만큼 충분히 두껍지 않았다. → The ice was not ____ to skate on.
questions.why: not+형용사+enough+to-v는 '~할 만큼 충분히 …하지 않다'는 뜻이다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. The stage was bright enough for the audience (see) the actors.
questions.why: enough for+목적격 뒤에는 to부정사가 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 enough를 사용하여 9단어의 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. The rope was so long that it could reach the roof.
questions.answer: The rope was long enough to reach the roof.
alt: The rope was long enough to reach the roof
questions.why: 「so ~ that+주어+could」는 「형용사+enough+to-v」로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. The tea was too hot for me <u>to drink it</u>.
questions.why: to부정사의 목적어가 문장의 주어 The tea와 같으므로 it을 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. Daniel practiced ____ hard that he became the team captain.
questions.why: 뒤에 that절이 오므로 so+부사+that 구문을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오. The film was too long for the kids to sit through. = The film was so long that the kids ____ sit through it.
alt: could not
questions.why: too ~ to는 부정의 뜻이고 시제가 과거이므로 couldn't를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 두 단어를 쓰시오. 그 소녀는 너무 키가 작아서 전등 스위치에 닿을 수 없다. → The girl is ____ to reach the light switch.
questions.why: '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'는 too+형용사+to-v로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 too ~ to 구문을 사용한 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. He was so tired that he couldn't walk home.
questions.answer: He was too tired to walk home.
alt: He was too tired to walk home
questions.why: 주어가 같으므로 의미상 주어 없이 too tired to walk home으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. The night was <u>too</u> quiet that I could hear my heartbeat.
questions.why: that절과 함께 쓰이는 것은 so이다. too는 to부정사와 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. There was ____ time for us to visit the museum before lunch. (충분한 시간)
questions.why: enough가 명사를 꾸밀 때는 명사 앞에 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 so ~ that 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (that절의 주어는 he로 쓸 것) Nick was strong enough to push the car.
questions.answer: Nick was so strong that he could push the car.

questions.why: enough to는 긍정의 뜻이고 시제가 과거이므로 could를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 세 단어를 쓰시오. 그 다리는 트럭이 건널 만큼 충분히 튼튼하다. → The bridge is ____ trucks to cross.
questions.why: 형용사+enough 뒤에 의미상 주어 for+목적격을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. She was too shocked (say) anything.
questions.why: too+형용사 뒤에는 to부정사가 온다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. The pool is deep enough for children <u>swimming</u> in.
questions.why: enough for+목적격 뒤에는 to부정사가 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 too ~ to 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (for a beginner를 포함할 것) The problem was so complex that a beginner couldn't solve it.
questions.answer: The problem was too complex for a beginner to solve.

questions.why: that절의 주어는 for a beginner로 바꾸고 목적어 it은 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. Mr. Park speaks Spanish well ____ to work in Madrid.
questions.why: enough는 부사 well을 뒤에서 꾸미고 그 뒤에 to부정사가 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 〈보기〉 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은? ㄱ. The lake was frozen enough for us to skate on. ㄴ. The lake was so frozen that we could skate on it. ㄷ. The lake was too frozen for us to skate on it.
questions.why: ㄱ은 형용사+enough+for+목적격+to-v로 옳고, ㄴ은 so ~ that에서 on의 목적어 it을 되살려 옳다. ㄷ은 to부정사의 목적어가 주어와 같으므로 it을 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: 다음 〈보기〉 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 옳은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은? ㄱ. The engine was <u>too noisy for us to hear</u> the announcement. ㄴ. She was <u>so exhausted that she couldn't</u> keep her eyes open. ㄷ. The label was <u>enough small to fit</u> on the bottle.
questions.why: ㄷ은 enough가 형용사 뒤에 와야 하므로 small enough to fit으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 so ~ that 구문으로 가장 바르게 바꾼 것은? The instructions were too vague for the new interns to follow.
choices: The instructions were so vague that the new interns couldn't follow them.
The instructions were so vague that the new interns couldn't follow.
The instructions were so vague that the new interns could follow them.
The instructions were so vague for the new interns that they couldn't follow.
The instructions were so vague that the new interns can't follow them.
questions.why: too ~ to를 so ~ that으로 바꿀 때는 부정어와 함께 쓰고, 타동사 follow의 목적어 them을 반드시 되살려야 한다. 주절이 과거이므로 couldn't를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 의미가 같지 <u>않은</u> 것은? Kevin ran fast enough to catch the last bus.
choices: Kevin ran so fast that he could catch the last bus.
Kevin was able to catch the last bus because he ran fast.

questions.why: too ~ to는 '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'는 부정의 뜻이므로 원래 문장과 의미가 반대이다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은? Because the storm was <u>so</u> fierce, the crew were <u>too</u> afraid <u>to leaving</u> the cabin, and the captain was not experienced <u>enough</u> to calm <u>them</u> down.
questions.why: too+형용사 뒤에는 to+동사원형이 와야 하므로 to leave로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 〈보기〉에서 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ⓐ The path was too steep for the children to climb it. ⓑ He spoke loudly enough for everyone in the hall to hear him. ⓒ The soup was so hot that nobody could touch the bowl. ⓓ She was enough patient to wait for three hours. ⓔ The window was too high to reach.
questions.why: ⓑ, ⓒ, ⓔ가 옳다. ⓐ는 목적어 it을 빼야 하고, ⓓ는 patient enough로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? The cave was ____ dark for the campers ____ their own hands.
questions.why: '너무 어두워서 자기 손도 볼 수 없었다'이므로 too+형용사+for+목적격+to-v 구조가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 가장 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그 다리는 너무 좁아서 두 대의 차가 동시에 지나갈 수 없다.
choices: The bridge is too narrow for two cars to pass at the same time.
The bridge is too narrow for two cars to pass it at the same time.
The bridge is so narrow for two cars to pass at the same time.

The bridge is not narrow enough for two cars to pass at the same time.
questions.why: too ~ for+목적격+to-v로 쓰고, pass의 목적어는 주어 The bridge와 같으므로 it을 쓰지 않는다. too는 that절과 함께 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? The child was too frightened to describe what he had seen. = The child was ____ frightened ____ he couldn't describe what he had seen.
questions.why: 형용사를 꾸미며 that절을 이끄는 것은 so이다. such는 뒤에 명사구가 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?

questions.why: not+형용사+enough+for+목적격+to-v가 올바른 형태이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 곳을 바르게 고친 것은? The manager spoke clear enough for the whole team to understand the new plan.
choices: for the whole team → of the whole team
questions.why: 동사 spoke를 꾸며야 하므로 형용사 clear가 아니라 부사 clearly를 쓰고 그 뒤에 enough를 붙인다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 서로 <u>다른</u> 것은?
choices: He is too shy to speak in public. = He is so shy that he can't speak in public.
The car was cheap enough for us to buy. = The car was so cheap that we could buy it.
The bag was not light enough for me to carry. = The bag was too heavy for me to carry.
She is too busy to join us. = She is so busy that she can join us.
The ice was thick enough to walk on. = The ice was so thick that people could walk on it.
questions.why: too ~ to는 부정의 뜻이므로 that절에는 can't가 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 〈보기〉 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은? ㄱ. The music was too loud for us to hear each other. ㄴ. He was so nervous to answer the question. ㄷ. The soup was hot enough for warm up my body.
questions.why: ㄴ은 so ~ that 또는 too ~ to로 고쳐야 하고, ㄷ은 for warm up이 아니라 to warm up으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? A: Did you tell her the news? B: No. She was ____ to listen to anyone this morning. (너무 속상해서 누구의 말도 들을 수 없었다)
questions.why: '너무 속상해서 아무 말도 들을 수 없었다'는 뜻이므로 too+형용사+to-v를 쓴다. so와 very는 to부정사와 이런 뜻으로 이어지지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 too ~ to 구문으로 바꿀 때 가장 알맞은 것은? The parking space was so narrow that the driver couldn't park his van in it.
choices: The parking space was too narrow for the driver to park his van in.
The parking space was too narrow for the driver to park his van in it.
The parking space was too narrow to park his van in it.
The parking space was too narrow that the driver couldn't park his van.
The parking space was narrow enough for the driver to park his van in.
questions.why: that절의 주어는 for the driver로 바꾸고, 전치사 in의 목적어가 주어와 같으므로 it을 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 옳은 것은? The hall was <u>enough large</u> to hold the crowd, but the sound system was <u>too old that</u> it broke, the microphone was <u>not loud enough</u>, the seats were <u>too few to seating</u> everyone, and the lights were <u>so bright to</u> look at.
questions.why: ③만 「not+형용사+enough」로 바르게 쓰였다. ①은 large enough, ②는 so old that, ④는 to seat, ⑤는 too bright to로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 가장 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그는 자신의 실수를 인정할 만큼 충분히 정직하지는 않았다.
choices: He was not honest enough to admit his mistake.
He was enough honest not to admit his mistake.
He was too honest to admit his mistake.
He was not enough honest to admit his mistake.
He was so honest that he admitted his mistake.
questions.why: '충분히 ~하지 않다'는 not+형용사+enough+to-v이며, enough는 형용사 뒤에 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? The coffee was so bitter that Nora couldn't drink it. = The coffee was ____ bitter ____ Nora ____ drink.
questions.why: 「so ~ that+주어+couldn't」는 「too+형용사+for+목적격+to-v」로 바꾼다. too ~ to에 이미 부정의 뜻이 있으므로 not을 넣지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 <u>못한</u> 것은?
choices: The path was wide enough for two bikes to pass each other.

He was so ashamed that he couldn't look at his father.
The rock was too heavy for the boys to lift it.
She was quick enough to catch the falling glass.
questions.why: to lift의 목적어가 문장의 주어 The rock과 같으므로 it을 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 바꿔 쓸 수 <u>없는</u> 것은? The box was light enough for Mina to lift with one hand.
choices: The box was so light that Mina could lift it with one hand.
The box was not too heavy for Mina to lift with one hand.
Mina was able to lift the box with one hand.
The box was so light that Mina couldn't lift it with one hand.

questions.why: enough to는 '~할 수 있다'는 뜻이므로 couldn't를 쓴 ④는 반대의 의미가 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? (1) The theater was ____ crowded that we had to stand at the back. (2) He shouted ____ loudly that everyone turned around.
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 뒤에 that절이 이어지므로 so를 쓴다. such는 형용사·부사를 직접 꾸미지 못한다.

questions.stem: 다음 〈보기〉 중 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고친 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은? ㄱ. She is <u>enough tall</u> to be a flight attendant. → tall enough ㄴ. The water was <u>too cold that</u> we couldn't swim. → so cold that ㄷ. The essay was <u>too long for me to read it</u>. → too long for me to read
questions.why: ㄱ은 enough의 위치, ㄴ은 that절과 어울리는 so, ㄷ은 to부정사 목적어 it의 삭제로 모두 바르게 고쳐졌다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 enough를 사용해 바꿔 쓴 것으로 가장 알맞은 것은? The signal was so weak that my phone couldn't connect to the Internet.
choices: The signal was not strong enough for my phone to connect to the Internet.
The signal was weak enough for my phone to connect to the Internet.
The signal was not enough strong for my phone to connect to the Internet.
The signal was too weak enough to connect to the Internet.
The signal was not strong enough for my phone to connect to it.
questions.why: '약해서 연결할 수 없다'는 '충분히 강하지 않다'와 같으므로 not strong enough for+목적격+to-v로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? A: Why did you leave the concert early? B: The music was ____ loud for me to enjoy the show.
questions.why: '너무 시끄러워서 공연을 즐길 수 없었다'는 뜻이므로 too+형용사+for+목적격+to-v를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 enough의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 <u>다른</u> 것은?
choices: We didn't have <u>enough</u> chairs for the guests.
She sang beautifully <u>enough</u> to win the prize.
The rope is strong <u>enough</u> to hold the swing.
questions.why: ②의 enough는 명사 chairs를 앞에서 꾸미는 형용사이고, 나머지는 형용사·부사를 뒤에서 꾸미는 부사이다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 가장 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그 소식은 우리가 믿기에는 너무 좋았다.
choices: The news was too good for us to believe.
The news was too good for us to believe it.
The news was so good for us to believe.
The news was good enough for us to believe.
The news was too good that we couldn't believe.
questions.why: believe의 목적어가 주어 The news와 같으므로 it을 쓰지 않으며, too는 that절과 함께 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 연결한 것은? The wall was very high. The cat couldn't jump over it.
choices: The wall was too high for the cat to jump over.

questions.stem: 다음 〈보기〉 중 어법상 옳은 문장은 모두 몇 개인가? ⓐ The knife was sharp enough to cut the rope. ⓑ The knife was too sharp for the child to use it. ⓒ It was so foggy that the plane couldn't take off. ⓓ The plane was too heavy to take off. ⓔ He was enough clever to solve the riddle.
questions.why: ⓐ, ⓒ, ⓓ가 옳다. ⓑ는 목적어 it을 빼야 하고, ⓔ는 clever enough로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? Jenny is not tall enough to reach the top shelf. = Jenny is ____ to reach the top shelf.
questions.why: '충분히 크지 않다'는 '너무 작아서 닿을 수 없다'와 같으므로 too short로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>어색한</u> 것은? questions.why: enough는 형용사·부사 뒤에 와야 하므로 late enough로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바르게 쓰인 문장은?

questions.stem: 다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분과 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것은? The homework was <u>so difficult that I couldn't do it alone</u>.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? 그 상자는 혼자 옮기기에는 너무 커서, 우리는 도움이 필요했다. → The box was ____ move alone, so we needed help.

The tea was so hot to drink that I waited.

questions.why: too ~ to는 '마실 수 없다'는 뜻이므로 기다렸다는 뒷문장과 어울린다. ②③은 의미가 모순되고 ④⑤는 어법이 틀리다.

questions.stem: 다음 〈보기〉 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. There was enough water for everyone to drink. ㄴ. There was water enough that everyone drank. ㄷ. The water was clean enough for the children to drink.
questions.why: enough는 명사 앞(ㄱ)이나 형용사 뒤(ㄷ)에 온다. ㄴ은 어순과 구문이 모두 어색하다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 so ~ that 구문으로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? The actor spoke fast enough to finish the long speech in time. = The actor spoke so fast ____ he ____ finish the long speech in time.
questions.why: enough to는 긍정의 뜻이고 시제가 과거이므로 that+could가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: The road was <u>too icy that</u> the bus stopped.
The bag was <u>light enough</u> for a child to carry.
She was <u>enough calm</u> to handle the accident.
The gap was <u>too narrow for me to squeeze through it</u>.
He was <u>so kind to</u> lend me his bike.
questions.why: ②만 형용사+enough의 어순이 바르다. ①은 so icy that, ③은 calm enough, ④는 it 삭제, ⑤는 kind enough to로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? Not a single seat was empty; the hall was too crowded for latecomers to find a place.
choices: The hall was so crowded that latecomers couldn't find a place.
The hall was so crowded that latecomers could find a place.
The hall was crowded enough for latecomers to find a place.
The hall was too crowded that latecomers couldn't find a place.
The hall was not crowded enough for latecomers to find a place.
questions.why: too ~ to는 so ~ that + couldn't로 바꿔 쓴다. ④는 too가 that절과 함께 쓰여 어법상 틀리다.

questions.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? A: Can you read the sign from here? B: No, the letters are ____.
choices: too small for me to read
small enough for me to read
so small for me to read
too small for me to read them
questions.why: 읽을 수 없다는 대답이므로 too ~ to를 쓰고, read의 목적어가 주어 the letters와 같으므로 them을 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 부분이 있는 문장은?
choices: The suitcase was light enough for the child to pull.
The corridor was too dark for the guests to see the way.
The engine was so noisy that we couldn't hear the radio.
The shelf was too high for me to reach it.
He is not old enough to watch this film.
questions.why: to reach의 목적어가 문장의 주어 The shelf와 같으므로 it을 쓰면 안 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 가장 바르게 바꾼 것은? The wind was very strong. We could fly the kite easily.
choices: The wind was strong enough for us to fly the kite easily.
The wind was too strong for us to fly the kite easily.
The wind was so strong to fly the kite easily.
The wind was enough strong for us to fly the kite easily.
The wind was strong enough that us to fly the kite easily.
questions.why: '할 수 있었다'는 긍정의 뜻이므로 enough to를 쓰고, 의미상 주어는 for us로 나타낸다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고친 것은? The bench was <u>too wet for us to sit on it</u> after the rain.
choices: too wet for us to sit on
too wet for us to sit it on
so wet for us to sit on it
wet enough for us to sit on
too wet that we sat on it
questions.why: 전치사 on의 목적어가 문장의 주어 The bench와 같으므로 it을 삭제해야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 〈보기〉에서 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수를 고르시오. ⓐ He was too proud to ask for help. ⓑ The pond was frozen enough to skate on it. ⓒ She practiced enough hard to win the contest. ⓓ The story was so moving that many readers cried. ⓔ The gate was enough wide for a truck to pass through.
questions.why: ⓐ와 ⓓ만 옳다. ⓑ는 it을 빼야 하고, ⓒ는 hard enough, ⓔ는 wide enough로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? The runner was exhausted, but he was ____ give up the race. (의지가 너무 강해서 경기를 포기하지 않았다)
questions.why: too ~ to는 '너무 ~해서 …하지 않다(못하다)'는 뜻이므로 '의지가 너무 강해 포기하지 않았다'는 문맥에 맞는다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 가장 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그 강의는 너무 전문적이어서 신입생들이 따라갈 수 없었다.
choices: The lecture was too technical for the freshmen to follow.
The lecture was too technical for the freshmen to follow it.
The lecture was so technical for the freshmen to follow.
The lecture was technical enough for the freshmen to follow.
The lecture was too technical that the freshmen couldn't follow.
questions.why: too ~ for+목적격+to-v 구조이며 follow의 목적어는 주어와 같으므로 it을 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 ㄱ~ㄷ 중 어법상 <u>잘못된</u> 것을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. It was too late for us to catch the last train. ㄴ. It was so late that we couldn't catch the last train. ㄷ. It was too late that we couldn't catch the last train.
questions.why: ㄷ만 틀리다. that절과 함께 쓰이는 것은 too가 아니라 so이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 so ~ that 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. The instructions were too vague for the new interns to follow.
questions.answer: The instructions were so vague that the new interns couldn't follow them.
alt: The instructions were so vague that the new interns could not follow them.
questions.why: too ~ to는 so ~ that+couldn't로 바꾸고, follow의 목적어 them을 되살려 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 too ~ to 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (for the driver를 포함할 것) The parking space was so narrow that the driver couldn't park his van in it.
questions.answer: The parking space was too narrow for the driver to park his van in.
alt: The parking space was too narrow for the driver to park his van in
questions.why: 의미상 주어를 for the driver로 바꾸고, 전치사 in의 목적어 it은 주어와 같으므로 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. The rock was <u>too heavy for the boys to lift it</u>.
questions.answer: too heavy for the boys to lift
questions.why: to부정사의 목적어가 문장의 주어 The rock과 같으므로 it을 삭제한다.

questions.stem: 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 세 단어를 쓰시오. 그는 자신의 실수를 인정할 만큼 충분히 정직하지는 않았다. → He was not ____ admit his mistake.
questions.why: not+형용사+enough+to-v 형태이며 enough는 형용사 뒤에 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 not ~ enough를 사용한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (tall을 사용할 것) Jenny is too short to reach the top shelf.
questions.answer: Jenny is not tall enough to reach the top shelf.
alt: Jenny is not tall enough to reach the top shelf
questions.why: '너무 작아서 못 한다'는 '충분히 크지 않다'와 같은 뜻이다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장을 too ~ to 구문을 사용해 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. The wall was very high. The cat couldn't jump over it.
questions.answer: The wall was too high for the cat to jump over.
alt: The wall was too high for the cat to jump over
questions.why: 의미상 주어 for the cat을 쓰고, over의 목적어 it은 주어와 같으므로 생략한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. The manager spoke <u>clear enough</u> for the whole team to understand.
questions.why: 동사 spoke를 꾸미므로 형용사가 아니라 부사 clearly를 쓰고 그 뒤에 enough를 붙인다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 enough를 사용한 부정문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (strong과 for my phone을 사용할 것) The signal was so weak that my phone couldn't connect to the Internet.
questions.answer: The signal was not strong enough for my phone to connect to the Internet.
alt: The signal was not strong enough for my phone to connect to the Internet
questions.why: '약해서 못 한다'는 not+형용사+enough+to-v로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 곳을 찾아 문장 전체를 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오. The tent was enough big for four people.
questions.answer: The tent was big enough for four people.
alt: The tent was big enough for four people
questions.why: enough는 형용사 big을 뒤에서 꾸며야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 so ~ that 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (it을 포함할 것) The gate was wide enough for a truck to pass through.
questions.answer: The gate was so wide that a truck could pass through it.
alt: The gate was so wide that a truck could pass through it
questions.why: enough to는 긍정의 뜻이므로 could를 쓰고, through의 목적어 it을 되살린다.

questions.stem: 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 세 단어를 쓰시오. 그 소식은 우리가 믿기에는 너무 좋았다. → The news was ____ us to believe.
questions.why: too+형용사+for+목적격+to-v 구조이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 too ~ to 구문을 사용해 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. He was so ashamed that he couldn't look at his father.
questions.answer: He was too ashamed to look at his father.
alt: He was too ashamed to look at his father
questions.why: 주어가 같으므로 의미상 주어 없이 too+형용사+to-v로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. The water was <u>too cold that</u> we couldn't swim in the lake.
questions.why: that절을 이끌 때는 too가 아니라 so를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 enough를 사용하여 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (for the audience를 포함할 것) The stage was so bright that the audience could see every detail.
questions.answer: The stage was bright enough for the audience to see every detail.
alt: The stage was bright enough for the audience to see every detail
questions.why: 「so ~ that+주어+could」는 「형용사+enough+for+목적격+to-v」로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 두 단어를 쓰시오. (too를 사용할 것) The runner was exhausted, but he was ____ to give up the race. (의지가 너무 강해서 포기하지 않았다)
questions.why: too ~ to는 '너무 ~해서 …하지 못한다'는 뜻이므로 포기하지 않았다는 문맥과 맞는다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 곳을 찾아 문장 전체를 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오. She practiced enough hard to win the contest.
questions.answer: She practiced hard enough to win the contest.
alt: She practiced hard enough to win the contest
questions.why: enough는 부사 hard를 뒤에서 꾸민다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 so ~ that 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (them을 포함할 것) The letters were too small for the old man to read.
questions.answer: The letters were so small that the old man couldn't read them.
alt: The letters were so small that the old man could not read them.
questions.why: too ~ to는 so ~ that+couldn't로 바꾸고 read의 목적어 them을 되살려 쓴다.

questions.stem: 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 세 단어를 쓰시오. 그 길은 자전거 두 대가 지나갈 만큼 충분히 넓었다. → The path was ____ two bikes to pass.
questions.why: 형용사+enough 뒤에 의미상 주어 for+목적격을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 곳을 찾아 문장 전체를 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오. The gap was too narrow for me to squeeze through it.
questions.answer: The gap was too narrow for me to squeeze through.
alt: The gap was too narrow for me to squeeze through
questions.why: through의 목적어가 문장의 주어 The gap과 같으므로 it을 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 too ~ to 구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (for latecomers를 포함할 것) The hall was so crowded that latecomers couldn't find a place.
questions.answer: The hall was too crowded for latecomers to find a place.
alt: The hall was too crowded for latecomers to find a place
questions.why: that절의 주어는 for latecomers로 바꾸어 의미상 주어로 쓴다.
